benchmark_compile_torch_backend: benchmark torch.compile performance with a specific backend and mode on a model
bench_all_compare_backends: bench all torch.compile backends and print a comparison table of compilation and running times
bench_loop_measure_inference: bench loop to measure average inference or training time per iteration for a model
enable_tensor_cores_gpu: enable tensor cores on a GPU with compute capability 8.0 or higher by setting float32 matmul precision
disable_tensor_cores_restore: disable tensor cores and restore the original float32 matmul precision setting
